results.name: alarm acknowledgements are bounded, canonical, label-free and reject corrupt storage whole
snooze uses configured elapsed minutes and repeated snoozes have new tokens
dismiss and cancel snooze remove an occurrence, never the recurring schedule
stale callbacks cannot undo a snooze or replace a newer occurrence
snooze delivery has exact early/on-time/late boundaries and reports a missed wake
delete, disable, schedule edits and expiry cancel pending activity; label edits do not
clock rollback preserves occurrence identity while snoozing from the new wall time
one thousand adversarial activity schedules preserve isolation and finite bounds
task and event validation rejects malformed types, limits, dates and impossible intervals
explicit-offset date parsing preserves millisecond precision and rejects rollover
snapshot checks reject lost updates in every edited field, without mutating the original
task/event conversion retains notes and dates and clears event-only end data
